events.title: Click Flip is in Steam Next Fest! Play the free demo now
events.summary: Hi everyone! Steam Next Fest is here, and I'm proud to announce that Click Flip is participating! The free demo is live right now, so jump in and start flipping.What is Click Flip? Click Flip is a short and satisfying tile-flipping incremental game. events.summary: I underestimated how many people would want to keep playing after they completed the demo. Now you don't need to go back to the main menu after every game!

events.title: Click Flip Free Demo Available Now!
events.summary: Start flipping! Download now and experience 30 minutes of satisfying tile flipping and incremental progression. You get the first 5 levels and the entire upgrade tree! The full game features 20 levels, 440+ upgrades, and an infinite challenge mode! Download the demo, and if you like what you see, put it on your wishlist so you don't miss the full release this summer!
